# pugixml 1.16

Unmodified upstream parser sources from https://github.com/zeux/pugixml/tree/v1.16/src.
Used only by the embedded-document worker to read bounded InDesign XMP packets.
Static library, XPath and exceptions disabled; no new runtime DLL. Unused writer/file APIs are
discarded by the existing function-section linker collection.
